verification.source: Configured PortalDot V3 RPC; separate post-broadcast verifier

costInterpretation.status: receipt-derived cost figure; not independently reconciled against the relayer's before/after native balance
costInterpretation.caveat: PortalDot uses pallet-revive. Do not infer a gas-only fee or separate fee/storage-deposit breakdown from these receipt fields alone. Runtime cost semantics and the relayer balance delta were not captured in this verification.

limitations: Evidence is recorded from operator-provided terminal output. The follow-up verifier queried the configured RPC separately, but both queries rely on that RPC and do not independently authenticate its operator.
This is testnet execution evidence, not a security audit or a production-readiness claim.
Historical lookup limitations previously affected the V2 deployment transaction; this transfer receipt was available and matched the reported block hash at the time of verification.

A later read-only reconciliation on 2026-10-23 queried the sender's EVM balance before and after the receipt block. The block contained exactly one EVM transaction, and the sender balance decrease matched gasUsed × effectiveGasPriceWei exactly. This reconciles the sender's total balance debit on the configured RPC; runtime execution-fee versus storage-deposit components were not separately decomposed.

A read-only follow-up on 2026-10-23 checked sender and recipient balances at EVM blocks 149240 and 149241. The isolated block contained one transaction; sender balance decreased by 7.82782148139542551 POT and recipient balance increased by 0.1 POT, matching the receipt and event. This uses the configured RPC only and does not break down the sender debit into runtime execution-fee and refundable storage-deposit components.

costReconciliation.method: Read-only transaction receipt, matching event, block isolation, sender and recipient EVM-balance reads at blocks 149240 and 149241.
costReconciliation.caveat: Verified through one configured PortalDot RPC, not independent RPC authentication. The sender debit is reconciled; the runtime amount is not split into execution fee and refundable storage-deposit components.
